meta.name: weekly-digests
meta.description: Generate a serial week-by-week narrative digest of a project's full claude-mem timeline. Splits the timeline into per-ISO-week files, then runs one consecutive subagent per week — each receiving the prior week's carry-forward block — to produce one chapter per ISO week of data. Use when asked for "weekly digests", "week-by-week story", "serial timeline", or "narrative chapters" of a project's history.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 把项目历史按周生成连续叙事回顾
copy.fit_line: 适合你,如果希望把项目记录自动整理成每周连续的叙事摘要
copy.tagline_en: Turn your project timeline into a week-by-week narrative.
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you want automatic weekly narrative summaries of your project history.

howto.what: Claude 会把项目的完整历史记录按 ISO 周拆成多个文件,再为每一周派一个子代理,后一周会读取前一周留下的摘要,最终输出按周排列的故事章节式摘要文件,并附一份周索引。
howto.when: 当你说出“weekly digests”“week-by-week story”“serial timeline”等词,或要求把项目历史按周写成连载章节时触发。前提是 claude-mem worker 在运行,且项目至少有一周数据。

say.text: 把 [项目名] 的所有历史按周做成连载摘要
为每周单独写一份摘要,按故事顺序排好
say.note: 每个周文件一个章节,后一章继承前一章的梗概。

say.text: 继续按周讲这个项目的故事
say.note: 从已有时间线继续生成后续章节,衔接上一周进度。

howto.what_en: Claude splits the project's full timeline into per-ISO-week files, runs one subagent per week, and passes each subagent the previous week's carry-forward block. Output: one digest chapter per week plus an index README.
howto.when_en: Triggered when the user asks for "weekly digests", "week-by-week story", or "serial timeline" of a project's history. Needs a running claude-mem worker and at least one ISO week of observations.

say_en.text: Make weekly digests for [project] from beginning to end.
say_en.note: Claude splits the timeline into ISO weeks and writes one chapter per week.

say_en.text: Run a digest for each week of this project.
say_en.note: Each week gets a file; the next week inherits the prior one's carry-forward.

say_en.text: Continue the story week by week.
say_en.note: The pipeline resumes from the existing timeline.
